subject.title: fix(agents): log Anthropic provider rejections with status, redacted detail, and payload stats

question: Should default gateway logs persist redacted Anthropic provider error-body text, or should they record only stable metadata unless explicit diagnostic logging is enabled?
rationale: Pattern and registered-secret redaction cannot make arbitrary provider-controlled content privacy-safe, while the default JSONL sink preserves the new detail field.

options.title: Metadata by default
options.body: Log status, provider, model, tool count, and payload bytes by default, reserving provider-body detail for an explicit diagnostic mode.

options.title: Redacted detail by default
options.body: Accept bounded redacted provider text in default persistent logs and explicitly own the residual content-exposure risk.

recommendation.title: Metadata by default
recommendation.body: Log status, provider, model, tool count, and payload bytes by default, reserving provider-body detail for an explicit diagnostic mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this person to both the Anthropic transport boundary and the core sensitive-text redaction contract needed for this choice.
